name: mavenhandle
description: Scan your mobile app for App Store and Google Play rejection risks and see what to do next, from your coding agent.

interface.longDescription: Connect your MavenHandle account, add your app, scan its source for App Store and Google Play rejection risks, and read the results and the next step. Scans use your account's free monthly scans. Paid work, such as the full report, fixes, builds and store submission, is bought on mavenhandle.com.
